Image time-series stack

Source: R/stack.R
fb_stack.Rd

Bundles a multi-date, multi-band image with its acquisition dates, band names and per-date clear-sky masks. All other functions of the package take this object.

Usage

fb_stack(x, dates, bands, clear = NULL, scale = 10000)

Arguments

x

A SpatRaster whose layers are the bands of each date, date by date (all bands of the first date, then all bands of the second date, and so on), or a list of SpatRasters with one multi-band raster per date.

dates

Acquisition dates, one per date (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD" strings).

bands

Band names in layer order within each date, for example c("B02", "B03", "B04", "B08"). Sentinel-2 band names are expected by the pretrained models and the default feature set.

clear

Optional SpatRaster with one layer per date: 1 for clear pixels, 0 for cloud, cloud shadow, snow or no data. NULL treats all pixels as clear; pixels with missing band values are always treated as not clear.

scale

Divisor that converts stored values to surface reflectance (10000 for Sentinel-2 L2A digital numbers with the offset removed, 1 for reflectance).

Value

An object of class fb_stack: a list with data (SpatRaster), clear (SpatRaster or NULL), dates, bands and scale.

See also

fb_read_stack(), fb_s2_monthly(), fb_example_stack()

Examples

# two dates of the California example, ten bands each, read with terra
f <- fb_example_files("california")
r <- terra::rast(f$images[c(3, 7)])
s <- fb_stack(r, dates = f$dates[c(3, 7)], bands = fb_example_bands(),
              clear = terra::rast(f$clear[c(3, 7)]))
s
#> <fb_stack> 192 x 192 pixels, 2 dates, 10 bands
#>   dates : 2024-03-19 to 2024-07-27 
#>   bands : B02, B03, B04, B05, B06, B07, B08, B8A, B11, B12 
#>   scale : 10000 
#>   crs   : WGS 84 
#>   clear : 100% 100% 
fb_dates(s)
#> [1] "2024-03-19" "2024-07-27"
